name: v2.0.1 - Hotfix: DiagnosticsOverlay Rendering Fix
body:
## Hotfix v2.0.1 - DiagnosticsOverlay Rendering Fix

**Released:** 2026-10-26

### Fixed
- **DiagnosticsOverlay (F11)**: Completely rewrote the overlay rendering component
  - Eliminated memory leak: Texture2D no longer created every frame (now cached statically)
  - Fixed invisible overlay: dark semi-transparent background now renders correctly via GUI.DrawTexture
  - Removed GUIUtility.RotateAroundPivot which corrupted subsequent GUI rendering
  - Added proper save/restore of GUI.matrix and GUI.color in try/finally block
  - Added visible borders, grid lines, and colored axis labels
  - Added session statistics line (duration, packets in/out)

### Known Issues
- NetworkDiagnostics.RecordPing() is not called from transport - ping graph remains empty. Will be fixed in v2.1.0.

### Installation
1. Download SilksongCoop_v2.0.1.zip
2. Extract to your Silksong installation folder (overwrite existing files)
3. Launch the game
4. Press F11 to toggle the diagnostics overlay

**Full changelog:** See CHANGELOG.md in the repository.
